grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and access your National Insurance record

grants.description: Access your National Insurance record to check for gaps
grants.purpose: To identify gaps in your NI record and determine which periods need credits

grants.description: Check your current and past benefit claims with DWP
grants.purpose: To determine if you automatically qualify for NI credits through existing benefit claims

grants.description: Check Child Benefit records with HMRC
grants.purpose: To confirm eligibility for parent/guardian NI credits through Child Benefit registration

grants.description: Access your employment and earnings history
grants.purpose: To confirm periods where you were not earning enough to make a qualifying year, or receiving Statutory Sick/Maternity/Paternity/Adoption Pay
To support your application for carer's credits if you're not receiving Carer's Allowance

revocation.mechanism: Contact DWP or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. Already-awarded credits will not be affected.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot revoke existing credits. Agent cannot transfer credits between individuals without explicit confirmation from both parties. Agent cannot make decisions on historical HRP claims or edge cases (wrongly imprisoned, armed forces partners) - these require human assessment and will be handed off.
